# Smart Live TV

> Smart Live TV (localhost:3200) answers one question: where and how can I watch this?
> It publishes live football scores, fixtures, league standings, team and player
> statistics, and the broadcast listings that show which service carries a given
> competition in a given country.

## Core pages
- [Home](http://localhost:3200/): Live scores, today's fixtures, standings and sports news.
- [Live Scores](http://localhost:3200/scores): Real-time football scores and results.
- [Leagues](http://localhost:3200/leagues): Tables, fixtures and results for major competitions.
- [Teams](http://localhost:3200/teams): Club profiles, squads and fixture histories.
- [Players](http://localhost:3200/players): Player profiles and season statistics.
- [Fixtures & Results](http://localhost:3200/events): Full fixture calendar and results archive.
- [Sports News](http://localhost:3200/news): Football and MMA headlines updated daily.
- [Blog](http://localhost:3200/blog): Editorial guides on fixtures, competitions and broadcast schedules.
- [FAQ](http://localhost:3200/faq): Common questions about scores, fixtures and broadcast listings.

## Competition guides
Each guide carries the fixture list, standings where applicable, and the broadcast
listing for the countries we have verified.

- [Premier League](http://localhost:3200/watch/premier-league)
- [Champions League](http://localhost:3200/watch/champions-league)
- [Europa League](http://localhost:3200/watch/europa-league)

## Editorial guides
- [Kick-Off Times Explained: How to Read a Fixture List in Your Own Timezone](http://localhost:3200/blog/kick-off-times-timezones-explained): Why fixture lists disagree about kick-off times, what BST and CET actually mean, and the two weeks each year when the usual time difference between Europe and North America is simply wrong.
- [Why the Saturday 3pm Kick-Off Isn't on TV in Britain (But Is Almost Everywhere Else)](http://localhost:3200/blog/saturday-3pm-blackout-explained): The 3pm blackout is a British rule, not a football rule. Here is what UEFA Article 48 actually says, the exact hours it blocks, and why the same fixture is shown live in most other countries.
- [Why the Same Match Is on a Different Channel in Every Country](http://localhost:3200/blog/why-different-channel-every-country): There is no global channel for any competition. Broadcast rights are sold territory by territory, in packages, on staggered cycles — which is why the answer to 'where can I watch this' changes at every border.
- [Sky Sports, TNT Sports, & Prime Video: Cost to Watch Premier League 2026-27](http://localhost:3200/blog/sky-sports-tnt-prime-cost-premier-league-2026-27): How much does it cost to watch the 2026-27 Premier League season in the UK? A breakdown of Sky Sports, TNT Sports and Amazon Prime Video pricing and what each package actually covers.
- [TNT Sports SD Discontinued on Sky: How to Watch Without Upgrading Your Box](http://localhost:3200/blog/tnt-sports-sd-discontinued-sky-alternatives): Sky has discontinued TNT Sports Standard Definition (SD) channels, blocking older Sky+ box users. Find out how to watch TNT Sports without expensive upgrades.
- [How to Watch Premier League 2026-27 Live: Complete TV & Streaming Guide](http://localhost:3200/blog/watch-premier-league-2026-27-live-channels-streaming): Where to watch the 2026-27 Premier League season live. Full breakdown of UK TV rights, official streaming apps, kick-off slots, and how to cut the cost.
- [Harry Kane Breaks Gary Lineker's England World Cup Goals Record — 11 Goals](http://localhost:3200/blog/harry-kane-world-cup-goals-record-2026): Harry Kane headed home against Panama to score his 11th World Cup goal, breaking Gary Lineker's England record set in 1986. Everything you need to know about the historic moment.
- [Sky Sports Is Raising Prices Again in 2026 — Here Are Your Alternatives](http://localhost:3200/blog/sky-sports-price-increase-2026-alternatives): Sky Sports standalone now costs £43/month. Third price increase since 2024. If you're paying it, here is exactly what you can switch to and whether it works for the Premier League, Champions League and World Cup.

## Notes
- Audience is international. Content is not restricted to any single country.
- Data sources: TheSportsDB (scores, fixtures, standings, teams, players) and
  NewsData.io (news).
- Broadcast listings name the official rights holder for each country covered, and
  each competition record carries the date it was last verified. Where a country is
  not covered, no claim is made for it.
- Smart Live TV does not sell, resell or provide access to any television or
  streaming subscription, and does not host or transmit video.
- Full-text corpus: http://localhost:3200/llms-full.txt
